structure: BoundedState<3,7>, BDF2/48k; same laws, both memories, early exit, no LUT/substeps/extra attempts

tda_guitar.note: All samples included, startup retained. Units CPU cycles per output sample at 48k. Both models one 48k step; control is the accepted Bounded/48. Continuous own history across RAM chunks. p95/p99 are histogram intervals, not exact values. Full audio I/O not measured. Initial reset failure is retained in original log; a separate verified recovery is explicitly recorded when present.

noise_accuracy.reference: Exact condensed f64, original full MNA residual checked at every step; independent full-MNA Newton failed at sample 80 and is retained separately.
noise_accuracy.note: Old 10mV count and diagnostic windows are retained; no new hearing threshold is assigned. Current/previous memory comparison has identical 48k time offsets.

noise_hardware_access_failure.stage: noise RAM smoke, before process creation
noise_hardware_access_failure.reason: Your access token could not be refreshed because you have since logged out or signed in to another account. Please sign in again.
noise_hardware_access_failure.classification: Review infrastructure failure, not a determination that the action is unsafe. No bypass attempted.
noise_hardware_access_failure.board_last_verified_state: Guitar full RAM run: PACK_RESET_VERIFIED, factory application in Thread mode, CFSR=HFSR=0. No noise image loaded.

guitar_block_bounds.method: For each N<=16384, bound every contiguous window by the sum of N highest bin-upper-bound costs from each adjacent RAM-chunk pair; cap bin bounds by exact measured maximum. Max across pairs. Conservative bound for recorded samples, not measured window maximum or WCET for arbitrary input.

guitar_queue_bounds.note: Upper bound on workload excursion over all contiguous intervals, using exact whole-chunk totals and conservatively histogram-bounded positive surplus on interval end chunks. Not observed exact latency. Assumes work-conserving sample queue with uniform arrivals. DMA batching/overheads not tested. Clock 600MHz. No extra numerical steps or model change.

exact_f64_reference.note: Exact condensed f64 BDF2/48 from zero memory; original full MNA residual verified every step. Global full-MNA Newton failed separately at sample 80. Comparisons cover successful prefix when incomplete.

noise_candidate: bounded48_noise.rs: optional noise48-candidate feature; separate from default kernel
